PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Checks that the health route exists and that 127.0.0.1 or localhost is in ALLOWED_HOSTS because Django rejects unknown Host headers when DEBUG is off
- Avoids depending on curl if it is not in the slim image, using Python from the image instead
- Explains the HEALTHCHECK interval, timeout, start period and exit-code semantics

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
